pr_title: Merge multiple ignored source entires for the same field
pr_body:
This PR fixes an issue with producing synthetic source when fields that need to be synthesized using ignored source are indexed multiple times in one document. Previously multiple ignored source values were not handled and this PR introduces logic to merge them together into a single field value.

Closes #111694.

issue_context.title: Fallback synthetic source produces wrong results in presence of object arrays
comments:
Expected is not entirely clear here for me.

Is it?
```
"_source": {
    "obj.k": ["key1", "key2"]
}
```

Or should it (can we make it) be identical to stored source?
This is actually a more generic problem, it reproduces without `subobjects: false` too.

> Or should it (can we make it) be identical to stored source?

I don't think we're able to sythetize to the original structure. I think the example result snippet is the best we can do here without storing additional information. This should be sufficient as both leaf values will be returned.

review_comments: Iirc the use case for this is when `store_array_source` is set. We can check for that and merge otherwise.
But we don't know which mapper produced this field loader at this point?
As we discussed today i think we can defer handling mixed case for now.
